args.memo: IC recharge from US - ICI-DE-02 (tooling recharge March)

args.description: US posted unsupported intercompany adjustment of USD 1,320 on 3/30 (JE-00306) with only note 'IC adj DE per call' and no supporting documentation. This adjustment does not correspond to any identified intercompany invoice or transaction. EUR equivalent (~€1,200 at 1.10 rate) is not explained by legitimate intercompany transactions. Requires controller review and DE cannot book their side until supported.

args.text:
INTERCOMPANY RECONCILIATION SUMMARY - US-DE
Period: March 31, 2026

RECONCILIATION COMPLETED:

DE's Intercompany Payable (2300) has been updated to reflect legitimate charges:
- Feb 2026 charge (ICI-DE-01): EUR 7,800 (posted 2/20, DOC-0125)
- Mar 2026 charge (ICI-DE-02): EUR 500 (posted 3/18, now recorded on DE books via JE-00309)
- TOTAL DE PAYABLE: EUR 8,300

US Intercompany Receivable (1400) carries:
- Original balance plus activity: $10,450 USD
- Equivalent to EUR 8,300 at March 31 rate (1.10): $9,130 USD
- Additional recorded amount: $1,320 USD (unsupported)

ENTRIES POSTED:
✓ JE-00309 (DE): EUR 500 charge for ICI-DE-02 (tooling recharge March)
  - Debit: 6200 (Software Subscriptions) EUR 500
  - Credit: 2300 (Intercompany Payable) EUR 500
  - Support: DOC-0190 (Intercompany invoice ICI-DE-02)

EXCEPTION FLAGGED:
✗ EXC-001: US JE-00306 (3/30/2026) posted $1,320 adjustment with no supporting documentation
  - Memo only states: "IC adj DE per call"
  - No invoice, email, or reconciliation detail provided
  - DE cannot legitimately book this amount without understanding its basis
  - Amount: $1,320 USD (~EUR 1,200 equivalent)
  - Related entries: JE-00306 (unsupported), JE-00272 (EUR 500 invoice), JE-00308 (FX remeasurement)

RECOMMENDATION:
Controller to investigate and provide documentation for the $1,320 adjustment before closing. If valid, a supporting document and DE's booking instruction should be provided. If not valid, it should be reversed from the US books.

Current status: DE's legitimate obligation now properly recorded and matches supported intercompany invoices.
